leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a graph data structure to represent network nodes and weighted edges
Initialize a distance array to track minimum travel times from the source node
Implement Dijkstra's algorithm to find shortest paths in a weighted graph
Manipulate a priority queue to efficiently select the next node to process
Update node distances when a shorter path through a neighbor is discovered
Configure the algorithm to handle edge cases like unreachable nodes
Integrate all components to calculate the maximum delay time across the network
